item.title: Climbing Mount Fuji: The Yoshida Trail and Climbing Season — Guide
item.description: The Yoshida Trail is the most popular route to the 3,776-metre summit of Mount Fuji, starting from the Fuji Subaru Line 5th Station on Yamanashi’s northern side and offering the most mountain huts, first-aid stations and facilities of any Fuji route. Climbing is only permitted during a short official season each summer, roughly early July to early September, marked by the traditional Yamabiraki (mountain-opening) ceremony, with most climbers timing their ascent to reach the summit for the famous goraiko sunrise before descending the same day or after an overnight hut stay.
